budget.release: Verified route, stock/lead time, stereo/content/purity plan, all-in quote; no overlap with coverage O4 if later selected

budget.scope: Up to four nominated compounds, CDK2/E1, CDK2/A2 and CDK1/B1; three independently prepared days. Planning 36 curves at $300 plus $1200 controls/interference; obtain real quote. Drop optional D01 or use contingency if adequate QC cannot fit.

Four compounds maximum; CDK2/CDK1 engagement at matched 2h and 24h in qualified comparable cellular format, three independent days; biomarker-positive, negative/impairment and nontransformed cellular contexts with matched 72h proliferation, 24h EdU/cell cycle and proximal pathway readouts. Technical duplicate wells do not replace biological repeats.

Soluble concentration/aggregation and permeability, human microsomal stability and cellular concentration at engagement timepoints, prioritize C39/C41 then advancing designs. Intracellular total concentration is not automatically free target-site concentration.
One authenticated orthogonal CDK2 reference standard if obtainable, vehicle/detection controls, cell identity/mycoplasma and CCNE1/Rb/p16 verification; no new standard synthesis assumed.
Quote overruns, QC recovery or decisive repeats only; otherwise unspent. No crystallography or mutant programme automatically commissioned.

stages.action: Resolve numerical W1/W2 results and QC, run proposed coverage recovery/repeat, verify comparator identity and quotes, establish existing cellular engagement assay readiness. Do not build an unqualified new cell assay and call it validated by day30.
stages.gate: If pending failed, explicitly propose O3 recovery using remaining reserve and document separate obligation; if assay/stock unavailable, hold dependent spend.

stages.action: Matched comparator biochemical curves and first cellular/exposure bridge; source-matched core and C41 availability confirmed.
stages.gate: CDK2<=100 nM and ratio>=10 in bracketed comparable curves; interpretable engagement or a diagnosed exposure bottleneck that the design actually tests. No core by day10: preserve optional synthesis funds.

stages.action: D02 synthesis/QC; D01 only if polarity comparison still useful and route is feasible within cap. Continue comparator cell/exposure work.
stages.gate: Delivered qualified material and retained stereochemistry; failed identity prevents biological interpretation.

stages.action: Complete three independent biological days, matched timepoint exposure/engagement and functional comparisons; analyze concentration-response intervals and freeze next decision.
stages.gate: No selective lead unless biochemical, cellular and normal-cell preferences jointly supported. A missing assay is unresolved, not pass.

curve_QC: Predefine 10-12 point log concentration series bracketing each IC50; 0.1 nM to 10 uM initial biochemical range, extend only within demonstrated solubility and assay tolerance; retain unbracketed results as bounds.
Matched 1mM ATP source-context CDK2/E1 and CDK1/B1 primary assay, plus CDK2/A2 sensitivity; qualify enzyme activity and reference inhibitor performance each day.

Preserve raw concentrations, plate maps, actual compound content, vehicle fraction, positive/negative controls, fit residuals, Hill slopes and repeat-specific curves. Do not average discordant QC failures into a pass.

Include compound-only/detection interference and detergent/aggregation checks as appropriate. An orthogonal activity/binding method resolves interference; it does not replace missing matching assay context.

Cellular ratios compare the same time, cellular context and qualified assay dynamic range. Use 2h and 24h engagement/exposure as separate ratios; functional readout concentration is not the CDK1 engagement denominator.

Fit/report per-day estimates plus uncertainty across three independently prepared days. If intervals overlap materially, do not rank small changes; select route simplicity or the informative next control. A conservative interval lower ratio below10 leaves advancement unqualified.

advancement_preferences.interpretation: Program decision thresholds, not clinical safety margins. Require working reference and adequate soluble/exposure evidence, plus biomarker-consistent function.

reversal: Authentic C39/C41 fail paired biochemical or cellular window despite adequate exposure and working benchmark: reverse main switch, not blind further substitution.
D02 loses biochemical preference without exposure advantage: drop; D01 worsens cellular translation without soluble-exposure benefit: drop.
Credible incumbent cellular window or qualified engagement rescue of purine73: reconsider branch allocation in same assays; do not compare historical ratios as if common assays.
No normal-cell separation across tested direction: stop advancement.
